name: ordomatics-connect
description: For Ordomatics customers: run your project on infrastructure you operate. Use when connecting your own Kubernetes cluster to Ordomatics, preparing one (MicroK8s, K3s, a managed cloud cluster), running the portal's connect command, or when the portal reports 'Waiting for you', 'Can't manage your cluster', 'Your cluster refused the token' or 'connector is not running'.
